title: OECD Producer Support Estimate for India

source.name: OECD Agricultural Policy Monitoring and Evaluation

points.note: Implicit producer tax estimated near US$169bn
Implicit producer tax estimated near US$120bn
2022-24 average; most negative in the OECD's 54-country panel

caveat: A NEGATIVE producer support estimate means Indian farmers are on net implicitly TAXED, not subsidised. Fertiliser, credit and income-transfer subsidies are real, but they are more than offset by export bans, stock limits and marketing controls that hold domestic prices below international reference levels. The net transfer runs from farmers to consumers — the consumer support estimate is positive at about 31.8%.
notes: The single most under-discussed fact in the domain, and it disciplines both partisan framings: neither 'farmers are pampered by subsidies' nor 'the government abandoned farmers' survives it.

title: Average monthly income of agricultural households

source.name: NSS Situation Assessment Survey of Agricultural Households

points.note: SAS 77th round; ~59% nominal but only ~16% real

caveat: The series stops here. No Situation Assessment Survey has been fielded since 2018-19, so the promise to double real farm income by 2022-23 cannot be evaluated against the only instrument that measures it. Agricultural GVA and NABARD's NAFIS are not substitutes: GVA is sectoral output, not household income net of costs.

unmeasured.why: The Situation Assessment Survey has not been repeated. The target was set in SAS terms and can only be judged in them.
unmeasured.wouldFill: A new NSS Situation Assessment Survey of Agricultural Households

notes: Crop income's share fell to about 37% by 2018-19, and WAGE income exceeded crop income for the average agricultural household — the average farmer is now more a wage-worker than a cultivator. Average operational holding shrank from 0.725 ha (2003) to 0.512 ha (2019).

caveat: Distribution worked; behaviour change largely did not. A redesigned card lifted comprehension of fertiliser recommendations to only about 33%, cards often arrived after sowing, and grid sampling did not reflect individual plots.
